claim: Physical SRAM addresses used by the blitter include a 040000 aperture offset.

evidence.text: Physical SRAM includes the 040000 aperture offset; high staging is 216-223.
N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone), core 3.03.00 (nxsuite D10): a blitter copy by physical address (RAM page n at $40000 + n x $2000) landed with 0 bytes wrong.
